import json
out=[]
for task in ["t001","t002","t003","t004","t005"]:
 page=brain.sandbox.trace("jb4798f05fa4941f88eacf20a40f42800",trial=task,limit=200)
 chosen=[];count=0
 while True:
  count+=len(page["items"])
  chosen += [e for e in page["items"] if e["kind"]=="agent_finished" or e["data"].get("method") in ["StartTrial","Answer","EndTrial"]]
  if not page["more"]: break
  page=brain.sandbox.trace("jb4798f05fa4941f88eacf20a40f42800",trial=task,after=page["next_after"],limit=200)
 out.append({"task_id":task,"indexed_event_count":count,"selected_index":chosen})
print(json.dumps(out))
